# Watchflare Documentation

> Self-hosted host monitoring with lightweight agents, gRPC/TLS transport, and an embedded dashboard. Agents report metrics to a single Go binary (Hub) with an embedded SvelteKit frontend and TimescaleDB storage.

Full text of all pages: https://docs.watchflare.io/llms-full.txt
